entries.en: Someone's napping on the table...[n]Do any of these kids ever think[n]about being considerate?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, looks like you can study here.

entries.en: Your [stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27] might improve[n]if you study at one of the open tables.

entries.en: What do you wanna do, study here?

entries.en: There aren't many people today—maybe[n]because of the weather...! That means[n]you'll be able to focus on studying today!

entries.en: All the books here look pretty tough...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't think many people ever check[n]these books out. They're all covered[n]in a thick layer of dust.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This book's title is super boring... Is there[n]anything more interesting in here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Who picks the books they have in here?[n]They should really invest in something[n]more exciting...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man, all these books are gigantic...[n]Getting hit with one would suck.
entries.uk: Ох, ці книжки просто велетенські...[n]Якщо такою влучить — мало не буде.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This shelf is jam-packed with books.[n]Most of them seem a bit too serious[n]for my tastes.
entries.uk: Полиця вщерть забита книжками.[n]Як на мій смак, більшість[n]надто серйозні.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Does anyone actually read these?[n]Well, I guess they're here to study...
entries.uk: Невже це хтось читає?[n]Ну, зрештою, сюди приходять вчитися...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmmm... None of these look very[n]compelling to me...
entries.uk: Гм-м... Жодна з них мене[n]не приваблює...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: These books look ancient... I feel like[n]they'd crumble if you tried to turn the[n]pages.
entries.uk: Ці книжки на вигляд древні... Таке[n]відчуття, що вони розсиплються, варто[n]лише перегорнути сторінку.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: These books smell... weird.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't wait any longer... We have[n]to prepare, and fast!

entries.en: There's nothing I particularly[n]need to do here right now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do you really need to sit down and[n]read right now? Save that for later.
